stem.text: The diagram shows a battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $6\,\text{V}$, connected in series with a resistor and a uniform resistance wire RQ of length $60\,\text{cm}$.
The resistance of RQ is equal to the resistance of the resistor.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram: a battery with a resistor and a wire RQ in series, a slider contact P, a length L marked between R and P, and terminals X and Y.

stem.text: Terminal X is connected to fixed point R. Terminal Y is connected to point P, a connection that may be made at any position along the wire. $L$ is the distance between R and P.
Which graph shows the variation with $L$ of the potential difference (p.d.) $V$ across XY?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis V/V (ticks 0 and 6) and horizontal axis L/cm (ticks 0 and 60), with one line drawn.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis V/V (ticks 0 and 6) and horizontal axis L/cm (ticks 0 and 60), with one line drawn.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis V/V (ticks 0 and 6) and horizontal axis L/cm (ticks 0 and 60), with one line drawn.
